declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme)
  (accounting :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumIntersection.PairWeightAccounting policy left.signers
      right.signers),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy left →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy right →
      policy.quorumWeight + policy.quorumWeight ≤
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.totalVotingWeight policy +
          accounting.intersectionWeight

declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme)
  (accounting :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumIntersection.PairWeightAccounting policy left.signers
      right.signers)
  (faultBound : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.totalVotingWeight policy + faultBound <
      policy.quorumWeight + policy.quorumWeight →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy left →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy right →
        faultBound < accounting.intersectionWeight
